templates.uploadVerification: Upstream tool verifies programmed application flash.
templates.platformioIni:
; Firmware: Arduino Uno
[env:uno]
platform = atmelavr@5.3.0
board = uno
framework = arduino
monitor_speed = 115200
build_flags = -fstack-usage
; Without LTO, -fstack-usage reports the code that is actually linked.
build_unflags = -flto
